fee_notes: Royalty Fee is a flat $475/month (not % of gross sales), payable in advance by the 5th of each month; may be increased annually on May 1 based on CPI-U plus up to 5% per year. Advertising and Technology Fee is 3% of Gross Revenues or $150 minimum per month (minimum may be increased on 60 days' notice). Job Fee has four components: (i) $15 per completed job; (ii) $40/month per Co-Op Line; (iii) $40/month per Market Expansion Line (if any); (iv) $10/month per OXI FRESH Business for Toll-Free Number. Optional Dryer Vent Cleaning Royalty Fee is 6% of Dryer Vent Cleaning Gross Revenues. Tech fee is bundled into the Advertising and Technology Fee rather than disclosed separately. Multi-unit franchisees pay Royalty Fee, Advertising and Technology Fee, and Toll-Free Number portion of Job Fee for each OXI FRESH Business.
